description: Navigate to the 'Canal Lock' activity in GCompris (often found under Science/Discovery or labeled 'Operate a canal lock'). The activity shows a boat, a canal with different water levels, and a lock system with gates and valves. Your goal is to guide the boat from one side to the other by operating the lock mechanism in the correct sequence (open gates, close gates, raise/lower water level). Complete at least one level. After the boat successfully passes through and the level is complete (or the 'Great' animation appears), take a screenshot of the completed state and save it to '/home/ga/canal_lock_complete.png'.
